name: msgsnd
synopsis: int msgsnd(int msqid, const void *msgp, size_t msgsz, int msgflg);
description: The msgsnd() system call appends a copy of a message to a System V message queue specified by msqid. It blocks if the queue is full unless IPC_NOWAIT is specified in msgflg, and requires the calling process to have write permission on the queue.

parameters.name: msgp
parameters.description: Pointer to the message structure containing the message type and data

parameters.name: msgsz
parameters.description: Size of the message data in bytes

parameters.name: msgflg
parameters.description: Flags that control the operation, such as IPC_NOWAIT for non-blocking behavior

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: The calling process does not have write permission on the message queue.
The message cannot be sent due to the msg_qbytes limit and IPC_NOWAIT was specified.
The address pointed to by msgp is not accessible.
The call was interrupted by a signal.
Invalid msqid value, or nonpositive mtype value, or invalid msgsz value.
The system does not have enough memory to make a copy of the message.
